title: The Death Of Us
overview: Explore the complexity of grief through a loving couple in a healthy relationship, shattered by the loss of their child during a violent home invasion at the hands of a cult. As they struggle to come to terms with their loss and its devastating impact, Casey, haunted by visions of a supernatural entity connected to their tragedy, and her partner, Danny, become entangled in the actions of the cult responsible for their devastating nightmare. Can their bond endure such unimaginable trauma? Or will their overwhelming agonised sorrow and otherworldly forces destroy them completely?
